title: fix(mcp): a failed flow run names the reason to relay beside its unchanged envelope
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DHmNQDjzMDfC82arJrj8Ao8)_

Fixes #32757

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP `run_action` / `resume_run` 遇到流程因业务拒绝失败时,原 JSON 一字不动,另附第二段纯文本,写明该转告员工的那句话(如「电子发票 is required」);两个工具说明同步教 AI 按控制台顺序转述。
- 为什么改:员工经 AI 提交报销被拦时,AI 原样念出 "Flow … failed: Node … failed: update_record(…)",员工看不懂;网页弹窗却直接说缺什么。按你裁决的 B+D 做,不改返回码、不与 `/actions` 分叉。
- 风险与回滚:把所有文本块拼起来再 JSON.parse 的 MCP 客户端会解析失败(只读第一块的不受影响);回滚 = revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `flowFailureRelaySentence` 与 `errorResultFromThrown` 末尾;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-refusal-details.test.ts` 新增的 #32757 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-action-refusal-details.test.ts`,预期 14 passed,其中 10 条是新增的 #32757 用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(本 PR 申报 Clause-② yes,席位先做契约复审)。

## What changes

- `errorResultFromThrown` (the renderer `run_action` and `resume_run` share): on `FLOW_FAILED`, after the unchanged envelope in `content[0]`, a second text block carries the sentence to relay, chosen in the console's order (`flowFailureMessage`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`): the flow author's `details.errorMessage`, else the envelope's `userMessage`, else `details.innerRefusal.message` (only when the inner refusal has a string `code`, as the console reads it). A failure that carries none of the three gets no second block; no other code ever gets one.
- `run_action` and `resume_run` descriptions teach the same order and say the flow and node chain is for diagnosis.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/mcp`.

Before: the agent read `{"error":{"code":"FLOW_FAILED","message":"Flow 'ebqu_claim_submit' failed: Node 'set_pending' failed: update_record(ebqu_claim) failed: 电子发票 is required", …, "details":{…,"innerRefusal":{"code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","message":"电子发票 is required"}}}}` as its only block and relayed the chain.
Now: the same first block, then `Tell the user this reason, not the flow and node chain in the error message: 电子发票 is required`.
Who moves: an MCP client that concatenates every text block before parsing JSON. Remedy: parse `content[0].text` alone.

## Why

Maintainer ruling recorded on the card (6837489229), options B and D after an independent review: the inner refusal stays nested (`FlowInnerRefusalSchema`, ruling B′) and `run_action` keeps answering exactly what `/api/v1/actions` answers (#31271), so nothing is promoted over `code` or `message`; the relay sentence rides beside the envelope instead. Step-0 reading on `main` c04aa295 in report 6836910294.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing run_action/resume_run refusal harness (`mcp-action-refusal-details.test.ts`), each case on both tools over the real Streamable HTTP transport:
- inner refusal: `content[0]` pinned whole (code, chain message, status, details), `content[1]` is the lead plus the inner sentence;
- read order: author `errorMessage` beats `userMessage` beats `innerRefusal`, each rung with the lower rungs present;
- no invention: no details, summary only, and an inner refusal without a string `code` each answer one block;
- control: a non-`FLOW_FAILED` code carrying the same details answers one block;
- descriptions name the three members in order.

Existing single-block pins (other codes and tools) are unchanged and still pass: the second block is keyed on `FLOW_FAILED` with a carrier.

## Acceptance notes

- The console substitutes its own localized line for a permission-coded or delegated-scope inner refusal; MCP relays the refusal's own sentence. The language of that sentence follows the caller's locale (`电子发票 is required` on MCP, 「电子发票不能为空」 in the console) and belongs to #32654.
- `/api/v1/actions` and the other flow doors are untouched; their callers read the carriers client-side as the console does.
- The stdio door does not shape `run_action`; the one renderer covers it.

## Verification

Head `7eaadf3b` (after one `git merge origin/main`, d52000e6; no `packages/mcp` change came in).

<details><summary>Tests and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: Test Files 63 passed (63), Tests 1066 passed (1066).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: exit 0 (tsc and the test-typecheck leg).
- Step-0 reading on `main` c04aa295 before the change: one block, `FLOW_FAILED` with the chain message (report 6836910294).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- No relay sentence at all: 4 failed (inner-refusal block and read-order cases, both tools).
- Sentence on any code: 2 failed (the non-FLOW_FAILED control, both tools).
- Sentence invented when no string `code` / a fallback: 2 failed (the no-invention cases).
- `userMessage` read before `errorMessage`: 2 failed (the read-order cases).

The vitest suite imports `src/` directly, so no dist rebuild sits in the ablation path.

</details>
